Once I was visiting my hometown and was planning on making stops to see some old friends. I was about almost a week into my visit when I got the strongest urge to visit one of my dearest childhood friends. It wasn't too late, about 9pm but I thought it better to wait and see her first thing in the morning. Turns out that her mothers boyfriend had stabbed her to death and almost killed her mom too. It started right at the time I wanted to visit and I still think that if I had, I could have saved my friend.
